newsitem.title: USA: Eclipse Surgical gets approval for PTMR.
newsitem.headline: Eclipse Surgical gets approval for PTMR.

text.p: Eclipse Surgical Technologies Inc said Tuesday that it has received the first Investigational Device Exemption approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to begin clinical studies of a new catheter-based approach to transmyocardial revascularization (TMR), called percutaneous transmyocardial revascularization (PTMR).
TMR is an investigational laser procedure designed to create pathways for oxygenated blood to feed the ischemic (oxygen-starved) heart muscle.
With the new catheter-based approach, the PTMR procedure is performed under local anesthesia by a cardiologist in a cardiac catheterization laboratory, much like balloon angioplasty.
Eclipse PTMR clinical studies will be conducted using a patented coronary catheter steering system with an articulating distal catheter tip, it said.
